replies.author: erofamiliar
replies.body: I played your game for about five seconds and saw a Mario sprite labeled "Mario". Mario is not just Nintendo IP, Mario is very well known and popular Nintendo IP. You do not have the right to use Nintendo IP, so at any time Nintendo could demand you take your game down and be fully within their rights. If you're considering fair use, don't. Fair Use is a defense you use in court. They can still sue you.
